36415.name: Blood Draw (Venipuncture)
36415.plain: Venipuncture (standard blood draw from a vein).

70450.name: CT Scan of the Head without Contrast
70450.plain: A CT scan of your head without contrast dye, creating detailed cross-sectional images of your brain and skull.

71045.name: Chest X-ray (1 View)
71045.plain: A standard chest X-ray taken from the front (one view), showing your lungs, heart, and ribcage.

71046.name: Chest X-ray (2 Views)
71046.plain: A chest X-ray taken from both the front and the side (two views) for more complete evaluation.

72148.name: MRI of the Lower Back (Lumbar Spine) without Contrast
72148.plain: An MRI of your lumbar spine (lower back) without contrast, showing detailed images of discs, nerves, and spinal cord.

76700.name: Abdominal Ultrasound (Complete)
76700.plain: Complete abdominal ultrasound with limited Doppler.

80048.name: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)
80048.plain: A basic metabolic panel (BMP) blood test measuring 8 substances including blood sugar, calcium, and kidney function markers.

80053.name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
80053.plain: A comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) blood test that measures 14 different substances in your blood including sugar, electrolytes, kidney function, and liver function.

85025.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential
85025.plain: A complete blood count (CBC) with differential, measuring red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, and the types of white blood cells.

93000.name: EKG (Electrocardiogram)
93000.plain: A standard 12-lead electrocardiogram (EKG/ECG) that records the electrical activity of your heart.

93005.name: Electrocardiogram Tracing
93005.plain: The tracing-only portion of an EKG, where just the heart rhythm recording is obtained.

99213.name: Established Patient Office Visit - Low Complexity
99213.plain: A standard follow-up visit with your regular doctor, the most common type of office visit.

99282.name: Emergency Room Visit - Low Complexity
99282.plain: An emergency room visit for a problem that needs some evaluation but is not life-threatening.

99284.name: Emergency Room Visit - High Complexity
99284.plain: A serious emergency room visit for conditions that need urgent and detailed evaluation, often involving multiple tests.

99285.name: Emergency Room Visit - Critical/Life-Threatening
99285.plain: The most serious level of emergency room visit for life-threatening or critical conditions requiring immediate intervention.
